title: The debt-close lint prints a heartbeat and runs one test family, so a debt whose Retire line names hooks/test_guard.py can close without a 30 min silent wait
why: Finding (coordinator 13:46 CST Nov 14, from runner 10's logs ready3400.log and ready3400b.log; triage read none): `merge 3400 --ready` hung twice, 36 min and 11 min, after `ste-lint: PASS`. A python3 chain with a 600 s-old `sleep` child sat under it; no output, no timeout. Other PRs get the next line within 3 s. Debt candidate named by runner 10: the ready step has no timeout and prints nothing while a step waits, so a hang reads as slowness. Cost: 47 min of the runner's turn, n=1 PR, 2 runs. Cause on #3400 unknown; its lane is reproducing the single step now and was told not to run --ready. Not an owner question yet. Kin: merge-tool-beats-every-phase (a timed progress line per phase; its phase beat merged in #3404), stall-watch-ends-quiet-jobs, ready-checks-job-qualified-steps. First act of a lane: read what runs after `ste-lint` in `--ready`, reproduce the hang, then red then green: a `--ready` step that waits longer than its limit stops and names the step, and every step prints a line within a stated time. Check change: if a verdict moves, round 3 applies. REPRO 13:47 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 13:49): the #3400 lane cannot reproduce the hang on its head; runner 10 is asked for one more background rerun with a process snapshot at the stall. Cause still unknown. CAUSE NARROWED 13:57 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 14:00, runner 10's fifth run, process probe at a 65 s stall, its log ready3400e.log; triage read none): the stuck process is the debt-close lint, not the STE lint. The poller python3 (age 69 s) runs with cwd /tmp/debt-retire-<random>/tree; its parent runs in the claude-settings checkout and reads its pipes. #3405, #3412 and #3413 passed the same ready step, so it is PR-specific: one of #3400's six debt files (docs/debts/red-run-*.md and notes.md) may have a retire command that waits in a bare temp tree (unproven; the lane is testing it). Two defects whichever file it is: (1) the ready step has no timeout and prints no row while a debt command runs, so a stall reads as slowness (cost: 5 runs, about 90 min of runner 10 time, n=1 PR); (2) the lane's earlier guess (a step child holding ci-job's pipe, bin/ci-job:513-519) is ruled out for this case. Not an owner question. CAUSE FOUND 13:58 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 14:01; the #3400 lane reproduced it: its own `timeout 120 python3 lint/check_debt_retire.py --upstream origin/main --head HEAD` hit the timeout; `ps` showed a python3 with cwd /tmp/debt-retire-<random>/tree running hooks/test_guard.py plus 11 python3 children in test fixture folders; neither the coordinator nor triage read lint/check_debt_retire.py). Mechanism, from the lane's read of the file on main (judge_close, run_span): a debt closed by a PR has its Retire paragraph read from the base; each backticked tracked test file in it runs in a bare temp tree under TIMEOUT 1800 s. #3400 deletes two debts whose Retire lines name hooks/test_guard.py (full suite, about 39 min, measured once), so the ready step runs the whole suite and prints nothing for up to 30 min. SHARED DEFECT (tool, not edited; the tool fix is to be filed here): (1) no way to run one test family; (2) no heartbeat; (3) a debt whose Retire names hooks/test_guard.py cannot close in a PR without waiting out the cap; the same limit made an earlier check_debt_retire run read UNKNOWN at 1800 s. The #3400 lane fixes its own files (keep the closes with a Retire-run cite if the lint accepts one and a run of this tree exists, else restore the two debts). Cost: 5 runner runs, about 90 min of runner 10 time, n=1 PR. The earlier ready-step timeout idea stays as a second check: a step that waits past its limit says which one. First act of a lane: read lint/check_debt_retire.py, then red then green: a Retire line naming one test family runs only that family, and a long run prints a row at a stated interval. A lint that reads UNKNOWN at its cap is reported as unknown, never as clear. LANE STARTED 13:59 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 14:03; lane created 14:00 CST; tags cs-build:lane, cs-repo, cs-step:ready-step-hang-no-timeout; Sonnet, effort medium): brief is a heartbeat line in the debt-close lint at once; the one-family run and the close-in-a-PR design go to the coordinator as a `Departs from:` line before the lane builds that part; no verdict that turns a refusal into an ask or a pass. Owner stays the coordinator.
